monetization.reason: No approved affiliate program or tracking ID is configured in the repository. The conversion improvement materially expands the neutral price-and-label calculator with product price, mandatory tax, mandatory fees, checkout total, blank-as-unknown behavior, a six-gate compatibility screen, package-fit and likely-waste decisions, an evidence handoff record, and an explicit no-purchase outcome. It adds no merchant, product, price quote, coupon, ranking, stock claim, fabricated test, product image, or paid placement.

image_qa.note: The dates decision guide, expanded calculator, and publication-inventory policy use semantic text, tables, local arithmetic, checklists, and existing brand interface assets. No cannabis product, package, food, vape, battery, merchant, affiliate, stock, or generated image was added or changed, so no exact-product mismatch or new licensing issue was introduced.

search_console.decision: The September 28–October 25 report showed 841 impressions, four clicks, 0.476% CTR, and average position 22.477. It is five days old and usable, but no unaddressed query or editorial page had meaningful volume in the roughly position-4-to-20 band, so no item is primarily Data-led. The Guides hub and Stem Cell CBG were already reinforced; About, Contact, Affiliate Disclosure, and Editorial Policy are navigational; Montana has two impressions; the HTTP, pre-roll, and federal-property rows have one impression; and Blue Dream sits mostly around positions 40–61. The report therefore prevented another overlapping CBG, generic hub, Montana, pre-roll, federal-property, or Blue Dream page while the batch filled distinct product-lifecycle, shopping-comparison, and release-integrity gaps.

authority.action: Published a citation-worthy cross-format product-date and condition decision reference grounded in current New York OCM, FDA, CDC, and CPSC sources. Its hard-stop gate, date-language map, five-record identity, six-format condition matrix, decision router, handoff record, and checkout path strengthen the storage, seal, recall, disposal, label, and price-comparison cluster through reciprocal contextual links. No speculative outreach target was added and no outreach was sent.
